meta.title: CasAI — Curated estates. Intelligent service.
meta.description: Boutique homes in Milan, Mallorca, and London — discovered, toured, and booked with an AI assistant that never sleeps.

home.heroEyebrow: Boutique real estate · Powered by AI
home.heroSubtitle: From a Brera attic to a Mallorcan finca to a Mayfair townhouse — discover homes worth the journey, and book a viewing in seconds.
home.featuredSubtitle: Each property in our portfolio is personally previewed by our team and verified by our AI assistant.
home.neighborhoodBody: Milan, Mallorca, and Prime Central London — three places we know street by street. Ask our AI assistant about your future address.
home.conciergeBody: Ask about square meters, sun exposure, or whether the lift reaches the cellar — our AI assistant knows every detail of every listing, in your language, around the clock.

footer.credit: A Follow The Flow AI showcase.

listings.title: Thirty homes worth the journey
listings.subtitle: From €700K to £12M across Milan, Mallorca, and Prime Central London — each property visited, verified, and ready for your AI-assisted tour.

listingDetail.askHint: Or tap the AI assistant in the bottom corner to ask anything about this home.
listingDetail.ctaBody: Our AI assistant confirms availability, answers any question about the home, and schedules a viewing — in your language, at any hour.

neighborhoods.title: Three places we know by heart
neighborhoods.body: Brera and Quadrilatero in Milan, Palma Old Town and Son Vida in Mallorca, Mayfair and Notting Hill in London. Long-form essays on each neighborhood are in production — meanwhile, our AI assistant has the inside scoop in three languages.

story.title: Boutique scale, intelligent service
story.body: CasAI is a showcase project by Follow The Flow AI, demonstrating what happens when a luxury real estate agency runs on conversational AI. The full agency story is coming soon.

contact.title: Speak with our team
contact.body: For agency partnerships, technology demonstrations, or to schedule a property viewing, the fastest way is our AI assistant — or write directly.

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.body: CasAI is a showcase project operated by Follow The Flow AI LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. Full legal information will be published with the production launch.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: Because CasAI is a public demo, no visitor data is collected, stored, or shared. The full privacy policy will be published with the production launch.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: All property listings, descriptions, and photos on this site are presented for demonstration purposes only and are not commercial offers. Full terms will be published with the production launch.
